$Comment: The yearly keepsake: help Santa on Christmas Eve, once a season, and keep the Christmas Ornament.
It inherits the yearly occurrence from Christmas_Achievement_Base, so each year mints its own copy and
@year in the title reads as that year. Feat files it with the feats, earned only. The merry tag counts
it toward the Merrymaker, and season_keepsake toward the Seasons of Orbis ladder; Christmas's Almanac
page names this file in Keepsake, and no other Christmas file carries season_keepsake. It pays nothing
itself: the ornament is Christmas Eve's own pay (Quests/SeasonsOfOrbis/_Christmas/Eve.json), collected
at Santa with the rest, so a player never has to visit the achievements page for the year's keepsake.
The _Christmas folder makes the id christmas_ornament.
